The highest shift is 160.8 ppm, which is more consistent with an aromatic or conjugated carbon rather than a carbonyl carbon. The IR spectrum also lacks a strong C=O absorption around 1700 cm⁻¹, showing only aromatic C=C bands. Together these data indicate that the molecule contains no carbonyl (C=O) groups.</thought>
